name: Vape cartridges and hardware
reason: The governing quantity for vape hardware is metal RELEASE into inhaled aerosol (coil/heating-element leaching of Pb, Ni, and Cr), not total product content. A total-content ug/kg limit would misrepresent the hazard basis. The aerosol-release test architecture — and whether hardware is factored per-category here or under one shared inhalable-hardware treatment shared with nicotine vapes — is a reserved governance decision for Karen (docs/governance/taxonomy-reorganization-2026-06.md section 4; category-25-step0-lock.md). No numeric standard is set until that architecture is locked.
governing_basis_when_unreserved: aerosol-emissions basis (mass emitted per puff or per gram aerosolized), not product-content ug/kg; Pb/Ni/Cr from the heating element are the primary analytes.
